title: Easy mode duplicate recommendation guard
summary: Block picking or creating a second recommendation for the same machine (or free-weight muscle) today in easy mode, reusing assertNoDuplicateToday shared with normal recommend flow.
testFocus: Easy mode step 1: pick a machine already recommended today — toast, picker stays open, no selection. After one full workout, pick same machine again — blocked. Different machine — allowed.
productionChecks: Normal recommend flow still blocks duplicates

deploy.frontend: GitHub Pages via push to main

asIs: Easy mode allowed duplicate recommendations for same machine today.
toBe: Picker and recommend step reject duplicates with existing toast copy.
